reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but the daily 'skip instead of move' decision is rewritten inline rather than pulled into a shared rule.

duplication.why: The skipsWeekendDays = skipWeekend && daily / isWeekend skip / otherwise getDateWithSkippedWeekend logic becomes a third copy beside getUpcomingDates and getNextDate.

placement.why: The handler sits next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates in schedules/app.ts as expected, though the weekend rule it carries belongs in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Any later change to weekend handling (holidays, new modes) must now be repeated in three places.
